---
title: "Calvarial marrow CellChat analysis"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(CellChat)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(grid)
  library(NMF)
  library(ggalluvial)
  library(scales)
})

# Analysis performed with CellChat v2.1.2.
if (packageVersion("CellChat") != package_version("2.1.2")) {
  stop(
    "This script requires CellChat v2.1.2. Installed version: ",
    packageVersion("CellChat")
  )
}

obj <- readRDS(file.path("results", "processed_combined_obj.rds"))
fig_dir <- "figures"
out_dir <- file.path("results", "CellChat_calvarial")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

cluster_order <- levels(Idents(obj))
cluster_colors <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(cluster_order)), cluster_order)
```

```{r}
calvarial <- subset(obj, subset = tissue == "Calvarial")
Idents(calvarial) <- Idents(obj)[Cells(calvarial)]

calvarial_vehicle <- subset(calvarial, subset = condition == "VEH")
calvarial_thc <- subset(calvarial, subset = condition == "THC")

run_cellchat <- function(seu) {
  cc <- createCellChat(seu, group.by = "ident", assay = "RNA")
  cc@DB <- CellChatDB.mouse
  cc <- subsetData(cc)
  cc <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cc, do.fast = FALSE)
  cc <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cc)
  cc <- computeCommunProb(cc)
  cc <- filterCommunication(cc, min.cells = 10)
  cc <- computeCommunProbPathway(cc)
  cc <- aggregateNet(cc)
  cc
}

cellchat_vehicle <- run_cellchat(calvarial_vehicle)
cellchat_thc <- run_cellchat(calvarial_thc)
cellchat_merged <- mergeCellChat(
  list(Vehicle = cellchat_vehicle, THC = cellchat_thc),
  add.names = c("Vehicle", "THC")
)

saveRDS(cellchat_vehicle, file.path(out_dir, "calvarial_vehicle_CellChat.rds"))
saveRDS(cellchat_thc, file.path(out_dir, "calvarial_THC_CellChat.rds"))
saveRDS(cellchat_merged, file.path(out_dir, "calvarial_merged_CellChat.rds"))
```

```{r}
p_count <- compareInteractions(cellchat_merged, show.legend = FALSE, group = c(1, 2))
p_weight <- compareInteractions(
  cellchat_merged,
  show.legend = FALSE,
  group = c(1, 2),
  measure = "weight"
)
p_interactions <- p_count + p_weight
p_interactions

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure3E_calvarial_CellChat_totals.png"),
       p_interactions, width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
groups_present <- levels(Idents(calvarial))
color_use <- cluster_colors[groups_present]

png(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure3F_calvarial_CellChat_diff_circles.png"),
    width = 3600, height = 1800, res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE)
netVisual_diffInteraction(
  cellchat_merged,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  measure = "count",
  color.use = color_use
)
netVisual_diffInteraction(
  cellchat_merged,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  measure = "weight",
  color.use = color_use
)
dev.off()

ht_count <- netVisual_heatmap(cellchat_merged, measure = "count", color.use = color_use)
ht_weight <- netVisual_heatmap(cellchat_merged, measure = "weight", color.use = color_use)

png(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure3D_calvarial_CellChat_heatmaps.png"),
    width = 3600, height = 1800, res = 300)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_count + ht_weight, ht_gap = unit(5, "mm"))
dev.off()
```

```{r}
cellchat_vehicle <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat_vehicle, slot.name = "netP")
cellchat_thc <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat_thc, slot.name = "netP")
pathways <- union(cellchat_vehicle@netP$pathways, cellchat_thc@netP$pathways)

ht_out_vehicle <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat_vehicle,
  pattern = "outgoing",
  signaling = pathways,
  slot.name = "netP",
  color.use = color_use,
  title = "Vehicle"
)
ht_out_thc <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat_thc,
  pattern = "outgoing",
  signaling = pathways,
  slot.name = "netP",
  color.use = color_use,
  title = "THC"
)
ht_in_vehicle <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat_vehicle,
  pattern = "incoming",
  signaling = pathways,
  slot.name = "netP",
  color.use = color_use,
  title = "Vehicle"
)
ht_in_thc <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(
  cellchat_thc,
  pattern = "incoming",
  signaling = pathways,
  slot.name = "netP",
  color.use = color_use,
  title = "THC"
)

png(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure3H_calvarial_CellChat_incoming.png"),
    width = 3600, height = 3000, res = 300)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_in_vehicle + ht_in_thc, ht_gap = unit(3, "mm"))
dev.off()

png(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure3G_calvarial_CellChat_outgoing.png"),
    width = 3600, height = 3000, res = 300)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_out_vehicle + ht_out_thc, ht_gap = unit(3, "mm"))
dev.off()

p_scatter_vehicle <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_scatter(
  cellchat_vehicle,
  slot.name = "netP",
  color.use = color_use,
  title = "Vehicle"
)
p_scatter_thc <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_scatter(
  cellchat_thc,
  slot.name = "netP",
  color.use = color_use,
  title = "THC"
)
p_scatter <- p_scatter_vehicle + p_scatter_thc
p_scatter

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure3I_calvarial_CellChat_sender_receiver.png"),
       p_scatter, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

cellchat_vehicle <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_vehicle, pattern = "outgoing", k = 4)
cellchat_vehicle <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_vehicle, pattern = "incoming", k = 4)
cellchat_thc <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_thc, pattern = "outgoing", k = 4)
cellchat_thc <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat_thc, pattern = "incoming", k = 4)

p_in_vehicle <- netAnalysis_dot(cellchat_vehicle, pattern = "incoming")
p_in_thc <- netAnalysis_dot(cellchat_thc, pattern = "incoming")
p_out_vehicle <- netAnalysis_dot(cellchat_vehicle, pattern = "outgoing")
p_out_thc <- netAnalysis_dot(cellchat_thc, pattern = "outgoing")

p_incoming <- p_in_vehicle + p_in_thc
p_outgoing <- p_out_vehicle + p_out_thc

p_incoming
p_outgoing

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure3J_calvarial_CellChat_incoming_patterns.png"),
       p_incoming, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure3K_calvarial_CellChat_outgoing_patterns.png"),
       p_outgoing, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)

saveRDS(cellchat_vehicle, file.path(out_dir, "calvarial_vehicle_CellChat_patterns.rds"))
saveRDS(cellchat_thc, file.path(out_dir, "calvarial_THC_CellChat_patterns.rds"))
```
